name: ntfy
description: Push notifications on your phone through ntfy (ntfy.sh or your own server): routines tell you what they found. One way: you answer in byob. Free, no account. Off until you pick a topic.

settings.label: Topic
settings.help: Install the ntfy app on your phone (Android or iPhone), tap + and subscribe to a topic: a name only you know, like byob-7f3k2q9x (on ntfy.sh anyone who knows it can read your messages). Type the same name here.

settings.label: Server
settings.help: Leave empty for ntfy.sh; or your own ntfy server's https:// address.
